review.tagline: Model-definition library for text, vision, audio and multimodal models
review.summary: Transformers is a Python library that defines model architectures for text, vision, audio, video and multimodal models and loads pretrained checkpoints from the Hugging Face Hub. It offers a Pipeline API for inference, a PyTorch-based training API, and `transformers serve` and `transformers chat` commands. Other training frameworks and inference engines reuse its model definitions.
review.audience: Python developers and researchers running or training pretrained models
strengths: Hundreds of architectures and 1M+ Hub checkpoints behind one unified API
Pipeline API covers text, audio, vision and multimodal tasks in a few lines
Definitions are reused by Axolotl, Unsloth, DeepSpeed, vLLM, SGLang, TGI and others
Model files are deliberately flat and usable independently of the library
weaknesses: Not a modular toolbox of neural net building blocks, per the README
Training API targets Transformers' PyTorch models; generic loops should use Accelerate
Example scripts are only examples and may need adapting
Requires Python 3.10+ and PyTorch 2.6+; RAM and GPU needs are not stated
needs: Needs Python 3.10+, PyTorch 2.6+, Hugging Face Hub
Models: PyTorch, Hugging Face Hub checkpoints, text, vision, audio
